Also triggers on: organize my drive, run the council, classify these files, drive drift, agent council, chain 1, chain 2, drive router, run smoke test, check drive audit, council memo, n8n drive workflow, supabase drive, CrewAI council, fire up the council, batch classify, council throughput, asyncio parallel, drive pipeline, file routing, drive inbox.
